I'm not a doctor, so take this as general info rather than advice — but the standard guidance for most SSRIs is: if you remember a missed dose and it's not almost time for your next one, take it; if it's close to your next dose, skip it and don't double up. Two days off can absolutely cause that wired-but-exhausted, jittery feeling, and restarting tomorrow at your normal dose is usually the safest default.

The catch is that it genuinely depends on which SSRI (short half-life ones like paroxetine hit harder than fluoxetine), so a quick call to your pharmacist is worth it — most have a line you can call even at this hour, and they can tell you in two minutes what your prescriber would want.

Which one are you on? And how are you feeling right now besides being awake — any dizziness or that zappy head feeling?
